verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Kong serves a real llms.txt file at kong.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with agent-facing directives, directly satisfying the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs; Kong also maintains extensive developer docs (developer.konghq.com) that could serve as agent-oriented references.  Missing for 10: richer content in llms.txt beyond basic robots-style directives, and independent (non-probe) corroboration that agents successfully consume it.
